item.title: Greenpeace pilot brings heat pumps and solar to Ukrainian community
item.description:
📝 “The pilot project shows how important decentralised, resilient reconstruction with renewable energy is, rather than fossil gas,” says Andree Böhling, Project Manager at Greenpeace. Heat pumps and solar energy now supply a large residential building in full, a first for Ukraine. Experts from Consulting IC Ukraine and CES Clean Energy Solutions supported the project.
🔗 Read more: https://www.pveurope.eu/power2heat/greenpeace-pilot-brings-heat-pumps-and-solar-ukrainian-community
